==Background==
"'''Dreamer's Beat'''" is an original Shibuya-kei song by 40mP. It was commissioned for the video game ''{{IW|ProjectSekai|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE!|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE! feat. Hatsune Miku}}''.

==Other media appearances==
===Discography===
The VOCALOID version of this song was featured on the single ''ドリーマーズビート (Dreamer's Beat)''.

===Video games===
This song was featured in the video game ''{{IW|ProjectSekai|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE!|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE! feat. Hatsune Miku}}'' (Virtual Singer version by Hatsune Miku; SEKAI version by Hinomori Shiho, Hanasato Minori, Shiraishi An, Tenma Tsukasa, Kagamine Rin, and Kagamine Len).
